Test PDFs that need external tools to make. All other test PDFs are generated by
`tests/common/mod.rs` when the tests run.

- `encrypted.pdf`: the "letter" fixture encrypted with an owner password only (AES-256), so it
  opens without a password:
  `qpdf --encrypt "" owner123 256 --modify=none --extract=n -- letter.pdf encrypted.pdf`
- `user-password.pdf`: the "letter" fixture encrypted with user password `user123`:
  `qpdf --encrypt user123 owner123 256 -- letter.pdf user-password.pdf`
- `signed.pdf`: the "letter" fixture digitally signed with Poppler's `pdfsig` and a self-made
  test certificate (signature field `Sig1`).
